experiments.name: Does vector volume improve trend retests?
experiments.treatment: Original trend retest: bullish vector break, confirmed uptrend, midpoint retest.
experiments.control: Identical rule with no volume threshold on the breakout candle.

experiments.name: Does climax volume improve sweep recovery?
experiments.treatment: Original sweep and recovery: bearish climax sweep, reclaim and confirmation.
experiments.control: Identical rule with no climax threshold on the sweep candle; both arms keep the same vector-zone target rule.

decisionRule: Review a hypothesis only after the complete fixed window, at least 30 trades in each primary-market arm, positive treatment net return and same-trade double-cost return, and higher treatment average net R than control at both cost levels. Require the same signs in at least one replication market with 30 trades per arm. Otherwise insufficient or unsupported; no automatic promotion to live trading. This operational screen is not a statistical significance test.
interpretation: Each arm is a separate strategy path with one position and daily loss locks. Removing the volume condition can replace pending patterns and alter later entries. Controls can include vectors. This tests the entry-volume filter, not all uses of vectors or causal market-maker behavior.
changePolicy: No parameter or market changes during the forward window. Any change creates a new protocol and future start. Missing data or unavailable warmup blocks a final verdict. Interim views never authorize trading; final review is at the fixed end date. No background collection or automatic trading.
